content.thinking:
I'm checking the claims about the io-shop account-page failures, including the peak error rate. The third one is whether the setting switched on at 02:55 actually lines up with the incident start, which it does on timing.

I'm going through the remaining claims about the io-shop incident, checking each against the record. The ones on who switched the setting, the estimated customer loss, the lack of paging, why the suspected change wasn't undone, and the draft fix PR #540 all look supported, with the fix still unapplied.

supported.quote: It started when a setting that adds a monthly spending summary to account pages was switched on.
No record that Argus read shows who or what switched it on.
